observations: Silver Yamaha keyboard with a blue LCD screen.
The model name 'MMS' is visible on the top right of the control panel in photo 0.
The brand 'YAMAHA' is printed on the left side of the unit in photo 0.
The keyboard has a standard 61-key layout.
The unit is shown in a domestic or workshop setting with other electronic equipment in the background.
A watermark 'BLESSED TUNESONIC VENTURES' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'MMS', not 'Mm6'. The seller's text is a typo.
The photo shows the physical layout but does not demonstrate the pitch bend function working.

claims.claim: All keys and buttons working, adapter included. Bought from the UK, no dead key, no crackle.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The LCD screen may be dead or have broken pixels.
risks.proof: A photo of the screen powered on showing a menu or test pattern.

risks.risk: The internal speakers may be blown or have distorted sound.
risks.proof: A video clip of the keyboard playing a full chromatic scale through the built-in speakers.

risks.risk: The power adapter may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: A photo of the power adapter and a photo of it connected to the unit.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the LCD screen powered on.
Video of the keyboard playing a scale to test the speakers and keys.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
